relations: A hand grips a wooden spatula whose slotted head rests among sausages inside the pan.
Heat from the stovetop produces visible steam rising above the pan's contents.
Moving the hand translates the spatula, which can shift or turn the sausages.
The pan stays on the cooktop while its contents continue to cook.
